why: M25-012. A target in docs/scaling.md says what an installation must do; a ceiling here says how much worse than measured a run may get before somebody is told. Each sits between the p95 the provider's size was measured at (docs/load.md) and its target, so a regression fails the nightly run while there is still room before anybody feels it; a change that moves one is a change to docs/capacity.md too. The longest prefix that names an operation applies.
